decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is an upgraded version of the well-liked BASIC 518 trommel screen, so its results likely meet the aspiration and there is little reason to search for other uses of its resources.
The firm upgraded the whole AK flail shredder series to EU Stage V engines, which shows continued commitment to a mobile product line close to its core business.

The mobile grinder got its own page in 2019 and fits the firm's core mobile shredding business, though dropping the related green-waste grinder (E) suggests the firm may consolidate its grinder range.
The CERON generation is described as setting benchmarks and is reported in use at customer installations, which supports keeping it even though the firm dropped another stationary shredder (D).
